meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Photography, Real Media & Provenance Visual System

principles.truth_first: documentary truth and provenance outrank visual similarity or aesthetic convenience
principles.entity_correctness: media must be linked to the correct entity/content context
principles.no_substitution: never substitute a visually similar local/public asset for the correct place/person/object/event
principles.no_randomization: never randomize imagery to fill empty states
principles.ai_policy: AI-generated/reconstructed media is never presented as documentary evidence
principles.effects: brand grading/effects must not materially alter documentary meaning

archival_photo.label: Archive
archival_photo.presentation: preserve archival character; restrained restoration only

artifact_scan.label: Artifact / Record
artifact_scan.presentation: no decorative crop that removes evidentiary context

ai_generated.label: AI-generated
ai_generated.presentation: never adjacent to evidence without clear distinction

provenance_fields.frontend_rule: frontend renders backend/CMS provenance; it does not invent or infer missing provenance

visual_direction.documentary: natural light, authentic atmosphere, human scale, geographic/cultural specificity
visual_direction.grade: restrained tonal coherence; preserve skin, artifact, landscape and material truth
visual_direction.crop: editorial crop may improve composition but must not falsify context or remove important evidence
visual_direction.overlays: text gradients permitted for legibility if they do not obscure critical evidence

ratios.hero: 16:9 or cinematic responsive crop with protected focal region
ratios.artifact_record: native ratio preferred; do not force-crop evidence
ratios.then_now: matched viewport/anchor when possible; otherwise disclose mismatch

then_now.pairing: real historical/archive media + real contemporary media preferred
then_now.alignment: align viewpoint/anchor only when evidence supports it
then_now.reconstruction: cannot silently occupy the Then side as if historical photography

fallbacks.missing_media: use designed no-media state, map/context graphic, verified text/story treatment or provenance-safe placeholder
fallbacks.never: scan local/public folders for similar images; random image; wrong entity image; unlabeled AI substitute

accessibility.alt: describe meaningful visible content and its relevance; avoid repeating captions verbatim
accessibility.decorative: empty alt only when genuinely decorative
accessibility.caption: provenance/caption remains available near evidence-sensitive media
accessibility.contrast: text overlays maintain Phase 02 contrast requirements
accessibility.zoom: artifact/document imagery should support inspection where product context requires
